subject: Post-call recap: ops alignment, milestones, and proposed decision outline
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Chris Ortega <chris.ortega@rposystems.com>, Jenna Hale <jenna.hale@rposystems.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: ops alignment, milestones, and proposed decision outline

Hi Chris + Jenna —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap while the discussion is still fresh and a proposed decision outline so we can lock on next steps. Please correct anything I got wrong.

Summary of pain & goals (as we heard it)
- Production latency spikes during end-of-quarter processing windows (p95 ~= 1.2s, p99 ~= 2.8s) causing slow downstream jobs.
- Unpredictable token spend on inference; finance wants clearer unit economics before scaling.
- Security/compliance check: need SOC 2 evidence and an audit log for inference requests retained for 12 months.
- Goal: pilot functional workloads in Q1 with a CPU/GPU hybrid config, then decision for 10x scale in Q2 if cost & latency targets met.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
1) Week of Jan 19 — Pilot readiness: exchange access details, baseline data, and sample prompts. (Owners: RPO Eng + Redwood Solutions)
2) Week of Feb 2 — Pilot run: 2-week technical pilot on Redwood Dedicated; collect latency/cost metrics and security artifacts. (Owners: RPO Eng, Redwood SE)
3) Feb 16–23 — Evaluation & finance review: cost breakdown and runbook for scaling. (Owners: RPO Procurement + Redwood GTM)
4) March 1 — Steering decision: Go/no-go and commercial terms to finalize. (Owners: RPO Leadership + Redwood Sales)

Key stakeholders we identified on your side
- Chris Ortega — VP, Platform Engineering (technical sponsor)
- Jenna Hale — Head of Procurement (procurement/contract owner)
- Anil Desai (Security) — we will loop in for SOC 2 evidentiary items once pilot scope is agreed.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Can you confirm the pilot start window (we suggested Jan 19) and the internal approvers you need to secure?
- Please share any specific security questionnaire items (Anil or security contact) we should prepare for in the pilots.

Attachments: attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan template (redwood-map-template.xlsx) and a draft SOW outline (sow-draft-v1.docx) for you to review — both have placeholders we can iterate on.

I'll follow up with a short calendar hold for a Jan 19 kickoff slot — feel free to adjust.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

From: Chris Ortega <chris.ortega@rposystems.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Hale <jenna.hale@rposystems.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jan 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: ops alignment, milestones, and proposed decision outline

Lauren —

This is great, thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Jan 19 is fine for a kick-off, but our data access team will only be available Jan 20–22 for credential handoffs; can the pilot window accommodate that?
- For procurement: Jenna will lead finance negotiations but needs an initial TCO estimate (monthly) for the Dedicated config you recommended (2x A100 equiv for steady-state, burst to 5x). Can you provide a ballpark before the pilot?
- Security: Anil asked that any SOC 2 artifacts and request logs be made available in a single S3 bucket with role-restricted access. He also wants an approximate SLA for log delivery timelines.

I marked the stakeholding folks on our side accordingly. I'll take ownership of the technical checklist and loop Anil in once we have the pilot scope.

—Chris
VP, Platform Engineering — RPO Systems
chris.ortega@rposystems.com
+1 (312) 555-0102

Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: ops alignment, milestones, and proposed decision outline

Chris / Jenna —

Thanks — I updated the attached MAP template with more concrete owners and a tentative pilot success checklist (see redwood-map-template.xlsx). Highlights:
- Metrics to validate during pilot: p50/p95/p99 latency by workload, average tokens per request, per-hour unit cost, and cache hit rate (if you enable prefix caching).
- Security handoff plan: we'll publish SOC 2 artifacts and an audit-log export script to the S3 bucket you specify; SLA for log delivery is configurable, default 24 hours after daily flush.
- Ballpark TCO: for the Dedicated profile we discussed, expect ~$27k–$35k/month depending on GPU family and reserved vs burst hours; I'll work with finance to tighten this before Feb 2.

I put a tentative calendar hold for Jan 19 10:00–11:00 PT for the kickoff; feel free to propose a different time. If Jan 20–22 is the earliest for credential handoff, we can still start onboarding docs on Jan 19 and do the handoff the following day.

Aditya (cc) — can you prepare the short runbook + list of S3 roles we need to request from RPO?

Cheers,
Jordan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-map-template.xlsx (updated)
